Claude session orchestrator (v0.4.40): a request tarball goes out to the
worker, a response tarball comes back, and bale validates, stages, and merges
or holds it.
positional arguments:
<command>
pack            Build a request tarball: goal, --include context, --write
forecast.
apply           Validate, stage, and merge (PASS) or hold (HOLD) a
response tarball; bare `bale apply` finds the newest one.
retry           Re-attempt a HOLDed session with a new response tarball
(same session id, no repack).
amend-checkpoint
Commit a desk-published checkpoint amendment over an open
session's blind oracle and emit the retry line (PLANNER.md
§5 steps 4–5).
relay           Record one exchange in a suspended session's clarification
thread and emit the counterpart's paste block; with no
file, re-emit the latest recorded round (BALE.md §8.11).
revert          Discard a held bale branch.
rollback        git revert an applied (merged) session. Defaults to the
most recent; --undo reverses a rollback; --list shows
status.
unlock          Clear an abandoned session (no git side effects), or
--integration for a stale integration lock.
open            Consume a planner bundle: verify, gate the pack argv, dry-
run the checkpoint, pack.
handoff         Repackage a bailout response into a fresh request tarball.
config          Manage bale configurables: `config init` walks bale.toml
(per-repo or --global); `config hooks` lists remembered
hook acceptances.
help            Show help for bale or a specific command.
completion      Print a shell completion script (bash) to stdout.
status          Show a read-only summary of this repo's bale state.
stats           Aggregate the claude/telemetry/ corpus into trust-ledger
rates.
options:
-h, --help        show this help message and exit
--version         show program's version number and exit
The loop: `bale pack` (or `bale open <bundle>` for a planner-authored bundle)
builds .bale/outbox/request-<sid>.tar.gz and opens the session; `bale apply`
validates the response tarball, stages it, runs the planner's blind checkpoint
(when [validation] base is configured) beside the response's validation.sh,
and merges on PASS or holds the bale/<sid> branch on HOLD — then `bale retry`,
`bale amend-checkpoint`, or `bale revert`. `bale help <command>` shows any
command's flags; `bale config init` sets a repo up. The worker's side of the
contract is docs/CLAUDE.md and docs/TARBALL.md in this install; the full tool
reference is BALE.md in the bale-src repository.
